Class KvCachePool

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.cache.KvCachePool
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class KvCachePool extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Physical KV-cache memory pool backed by a RadixCache for prefix-sharing across requests.

On CUDA, sizing follows SGLang --mem-fraction-static (y): 

  staticBudget   = totalGpuMemory × y          // weights + static pools + KV
  dynamicReserve = totalGpuMemory × (1 − y)    // activations / temps (left free)
  kvBudget       = staticBudget − memoryAlreadyUsed
  numSlots       = min(kvBudget / bytesPerToken, maxBatchSize × maxSeqLen)
Call allocate(KvCacheLayout, Device, ScalarType, double, int) only after model weights (and any other static pools such as DeltaNet state) are on device so memoryAlreadyUsed is correct.

Slot indices are managed as fixed-size pages. The embedded RadixCache maps token prefixes to those indices so that shared system prompts and conversation history can be reused without recomputation. Attention layers write and read activations through put(int, int, Tensor, Tensor) / get(int, int) using a per-request slot map established by bindRequests(int, int) or bindWithPrefix(int[], int).

The pool is static: bind claims free pages only and never grows the underlying buffers. When the requested capacity exceeds free pages (after radix eviction), bind clamps to what is available. Generation should stop at requestCapacity() and return partial results rather than allocating more KV.

    • allocate

      public static KvCachePool allocate(KvCacheLayout layout, Device device, ScalarType dtype, double memFraction, int pageSize)
      Allocates a pool using SGLang mem-fraction-static semantics.

      Call this after model weights (and other static buffers) are loaded. On CUDA, memFraction is applied to total device memory; KV receives whatever remains inside that static region.

      Parameters:
      layout - family-agnostic cache layout.
      device - compute device.
      dtype - cache element dtype (typically the model weight dtype).
      memFraction - static-region fraction of total GPU memory ((0, 1]).
      pageSize - tokens per page.
      Returns:
      the allocated pool.

    • forMtp

      public static KvCachePool forMtp(KvCacheLayout layout, Device device, ScalarType dtype, int pageSize)
      Creates a small fixed-size pool sized to maxBatchSize × maxSeqLen (page-aligned) for the MTP draft head's own short-lived, per-round KV cache. Unlike the main model's allocate(KvCacheLayout, Device, ScalarType, double, int), this is not sized by a fraction of free device memory — the draft window is tiny and fixed — but it must still use the model's real KV cache dtype and page size, not forTesting(KvCacheLayout, Device)'s CPU-unit-test-only defaults (float32, page size 1): a production batched draft step (multiple concurrent requests' MTP rounds sharing one FlashInfer decode call) crashed with an illegal memory access until this matched the main pool's real dtype/page size.
      Parameters:
      layout - cache layout.
      device - compute device.
      dtype - element dtype (the model's real KV cache dtype).
      pageSize - tokens per page (the model's real KV cache page size).
      Returns:
      the MTP pool.

    • forMtpHistory

      public static KvCachePool forMtpHistory(KvCacheLayout layout, Device device, ScalarType dtype, int pageSize, int wantSlots)
      Creates the MTP draft head's persistent, request-bound KV pool (one logical sequence history per bound request, like the main pool but for the draft layer(s) only). Slot count mirrors the main pool's (wantSlots) so any request the main pool can hold fits here, capped to half of the currently free device memory so it can never starve the working set. Prefix reuse is off (the draft history is rebuilt from hidden states, not from radix pages).
      Parameters:
      layout - MTP cache layout (draft layers / local KV heads / head dim).
      device - compute device.
      dtype - element dtype (the model's real KV cache dtype).
      pageSize - tokens per page (the main pool's page size).
      wantSlots - desired slot count (typically the main pool's numSlots()).
      Returns:
      the MTP history pool.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if not even one page fits.

      public void prepareVerifyGraphStep(int[] cacheLengths, int[] startPositions, int windowLen)
      Updates FlashInfer metadata and the flat [batch*windowLen] KV write-index buffer before a batched eager verify forward whose rows belong to different concurrent requests at different absolute cache lengths — the multi-request counterpart of prepareVerifyGraphStep(int, int[], int), which requires a single cacheLen shared by every row (fine for the single-request / graph-capturable cohort that method still serves).

    • verifyQoIndptrBuf

      public Tensor verifyQoIndptrBuf(int batch, int windowLen)
      Returns a stable query-side CSR [batch+1] tensor with values [0, windowLen, 2*windowLen, ...], rebuilt (new address) only when the (batch, windowLen) bucket changes. Callers that need a fixed address across a captured verify graph's lifetime must only call this once per bucket, before capture, and reuse the returned tensor for every replay in that bucket.
      Parameters:

    • bindRequests

      public void bindRequests(int batchSize, int capacity)
      Reserves a page-aligned slot map for each item in a batch. Must be called before put(int, int, Tensor, Tensor)/get(int, int) for a request. Previously bound slots (including multi-request bindings) are released without radix insert. Physical pages need not be contiguous (paged attention).

      Capacity is page-aligned and clamped to free pages in the static pool (after radix eviction). The pool never grows. Callers should read requestCapacity() and stop generation at that limit.

      Parameters:
      batchSize - number of parallel requests.
      capacity - desired slots reserved per request (prompt + generation).
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no page can be reserved per request.

    • bindWithPrefix

      public int bindWithPrefix(int[] promptTokens, int totalCapacity)
      Match a prompt against the radix tree, lock the matched node, allocate suffix/decode slots, and bind a slot map for batch size 1.

      Clears any multi-request bindings first so LanguageModel.generate(int[], int, double, double, boolean, long, GenerationListener) remains exclusive.

      Desired totalCapacity is clamped to matched prefix plus free private pages. The static pool never grows. If the prompt itself cannot fit after clamping, this method throws.

      Parameters:
      promptTokens - prompt token ids.
      totalCapacity - desired slots (prompt + generation headroom).
      Returns:
      page-aligned matched prefix length (0 if miss or reuse disabled).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the prompt cannot fit in free KV slots.

    • bindRequest

      public int bindRequest(int[] promptTokens, int totalCapacity)
      Allocates slots for one request without clearing other multi-request bindings. If the multi-request map was empty, activates this request.

      Requires the full totalCapacity (page-aligned). When free KV is insufficient, throws KvCacheExhaustedException so the caller can leave the job queued until Instant Eviction frees pages.

      Parameters:
      promptTokens - prompt token ids.
      totalCapacity - desired slots (prompt + generation headroom).
      Returns:
      request id (> 0).
      Throws:
      KvCacheExhaustedException - if the pool cannot reserve totalCapacity.

    • unbindRequests

      public void unbindRequests()
      Releases slots reserved by bindRequests(int, int) / bindWithPrefix(int[], int) (and any multi-request bindings) without inserting into the radix tree. Tree-owned matched pages are not freed.

    • ensureRequest

      public void ensureRequest(int batchSize, int endPos)
      Ensures a request binding exists and is large enough for endPos. Never grows the static pool: if capacity is insufficient, throws KvCacheExhaustedException. Callers must bind up front and stop generation at requestCapacity().

      When capacities differ across the active step, each requestSlots[b].length must be >= endPos.

      Parameters:
      batchSize - number of parallel requests.
      endPos - exclusive end position that will be accessed.
      Throws:
      KvCacheExhaustedException - if unbound or endPos exceeds capacity.

    • sealLength

      public boolean sealLength(int sealedLen)
      Seals the readable KV length for the active step without freeing pages. Rebuilds FlashInfer CSR for sealedLen so attention cannot see positions >= sealedLen (required after speculative reject).
      Parameters:
      sealedLen - inclusive committed token count ([0, sealedLen)).
      Returns:
      true when the existing CSR was bumped in place (same tensor addresses survive); false when it was rebuilt (a genuine page-boundary crossing, or a ragged step) — callers holding a captured CUDA graph keyed to the old CSR addresses must invalidate it when this returns false.

    • invalidateRange

      public void invalidateRange(int fromPos, int endPos)
      Zeros K/V for positions [fromPos, endPos) on every layer of the active batch (defense-in-depth for rejected speculative tails that share a KV page with committed tokens).
      Parameters:
      fromPos - inclusive start position.
      endPos - exclusive end position.

    • alloc

      public long[] alloc(int numTokens)
      Allocates numTokens slots (page-aligned) and returns their indices. Used by the inference engine when inserting into the radix tree.

      Pages are packed from the free list and need not be physically contiguous. Within each page, slot indices remain pageId * pageSize + offset so FlashInfer / gather paths can treat the result as a standard page table.

      Parameters:
      numTokens - number of tokens to allocate.
      Returns:
      slot indices of length alignedLen.

      Parameters:
